games:2026-wk10-byu-utah.blurb: The Holy War has real playoff weight this year: No. 7 BYU at No. 3 Utah, with the Utes laying 5.5 and holding a 65.7% win probability. The 48.5 total says both defenses are expected to show up.

games:2026-wk10-georgia-ole-miss.blurb: No. 2 Georgia is a rare road favorite at just 3.5 over No. 12 Ole Miss, and ESPN's model has it close to a coin flip at 55.5-44.5. The Rebels can rewrite their entire postseason case in one night.

games:2026-wk10-alabama-lsu.blurb: No. 9 Alabama visits No. 15 LSU in Baton Rouge with the Tigers favored by 5.5 and sitting at a 57% win probability. Both sides need this one to stay in the at-large conversation.

games:2026-wk10-kentucky-tennessee.blurb: No. 8 Kentucky is a 6.5-point underdog at No. 16 Tennessee despite the ranking gap, with ESPN giving the Vols a 66.8% shot. A Wildcats loss would scramble the SEC picture behind Georgia.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-ucla-minnesota.blurb: No. 5 UCLA hits the road at Minnesota favored by 5.5, with a 67.9% win probability and a modest 39.5 total. The Bruins can't afford a slip with Indiana one spot behind them in the Big Ten race.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-cincinnati-hou.blurb: No. 17 Houston hosts Cincinnati as an 11.5-point favorite with the highest total on the board at 62.5. ESPN gives the Cougars an 83.9% chance to keep rolling.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-boise-state-co.blurb: No. 20 Boise State is a 17.5-point favorite at Colorado State, with ESPN giving the Broncos a 93.1% shot and the total up at 68.5. Anything close would be a problem.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-merrimack-wake.blurb: No. 14 Wake Forest welcomes Merrimack in a no-line tune-up. The Demon Deacons just need a tidy, healthy afternoon before the schedule tightens again.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-texas-a-m-sout.blurb: No. 23 South Carolina lays seven at home against Texas A&M in a game the market and the model don't quite agree on -- ESPN gives the Gamecocks just a 54.1% edge despite the touchdown spread. With a 51.5 total pointing to a grinder, the Aggies only need to keep it close to make the Gamecocks sweat their ranking.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-iowa-northwest.blurb: No. 21 Iowa is a 2.5-point underdog at Northwestern, with ESPN giving the Wildcats a slim 55.2% edge. A loss to an unranked host would be costly for the Hawkeyes.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA climbed to No. 5 and leads the Big Ten race, yet the computers are skeptical -- 17th in SP+ and 28th in FPI. The resume is ahead of the profile.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky is up to No. 8, but SP+ (31) and FPI (26) both have the Wildcats outside the top 25 entirely. Saturday at Tennessee is a chance to settle the argument.

predictions:utah.blurb: Utah jumped from No. 6 to No. 3 and the models mostly agree it belongs, with matching No. 10 marks in SP+ and FPI. Beating BYU would push the resume closer to the ranking.

predictions:lsu.blurb: LSU is stuck at No. 15 while SP+ (3) and FPI (5) both call it a top-five team. Hosting Alabama is exactly the kind of game that closes that gap.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: The Big Ten's automatic bid is a one-spot fight: No. 5 UCLA leads, with No. 6 Indiana breathing down its neck. One stumble flips the league.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: Utah holds the Big 12 lead at No. 3 with BYU four spots back at No. 7 -- and the two meet head-to-head this week, so the gap gets settled on the field.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: Georgia has the SEC's auto bid comfortably at No. 2, six spots clear of No. 8 Kentucky. The Bulldogs' trip to Ole Miss is the clearest path to tightening it.

bubbleNotes:ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss sits at the 13 seed, one spot outside the field, and draws No. 2 Georgia next. Win it and the Rebels aren't on the bubble anymore.

bubbleNotes:lsu.blurb: LSU is the last team in the bubble band at No. 16, four spots from the field, with No. 9 Alabama coming to Baton Rouge. It's the best possible chance to move.

bubbleNotes:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest is stuck at the 15 seed, three spots from the field with no upward movement. Staying put won't be enough much longer.

games:2026-wk10-miami-notre-dame.blurb: No. 1 Miami heads to South Bend as a 6-point underdog to No. 4 Notre Dame, with ESPN giving the Irish a 61% edge at home. A 57.5 total suggests points will come, and the loser's grip on a top-four playoff spot gets a lot shakier.

games:2026-wk10-texas-missouri.blurb: No. 10 Texas is a 2.5-point favorite at No. 19 Missouri, though ESPN's model is far more bullish on the Longhorns at 71%. The 42.5 total points to a grinding afternoon in Columbia, and the winner stays squarely in the at-large conversation.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-oregon-ohio-st.blurb: Unranked Oregon visits No. 11 Ohio State as a 7.5-point dog, with ESPN giving the Buckeyes an 83% win probability. The 46.5 total hints at a defensive afternoon in Columbus.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-oklahoma-flori.blurb: No. 25 Florida lays 6 at home against Oklahoma, a 64% favorite by ESPN's model. The Gators' ranking is fresh and fragile, so a stumble here would cost them the little cushion they have.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-new-mexico-nev.blurb: No. 22 New Mexico goes to Nevada favored by 9.5 with an 81% win probability, in a game with a modest 37.5 total. The Lobos can't afford a slip if they want to hold their spot in the rankings.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-west-virginia-.blurb: No. 13 Texas Tech is a 17.5-point home favorite over West Virginia and an 89% pick by ESPN's model. With the total at 64.5, the Red Raiders have a chance to make a loud statement for their playoff case.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-tcu-arizona.blurb: No. 24 Arizona hosts TCU as a 9.5-point favorite, with ESPN giving the Wildcats a 74% shot. The 43.5 total suggests a game Arizona wins by controlling the pace rather than trading scores.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State dropped from No. 2 to No. 11 in the polls, but the advanced numbers haven't budged: the Buckeyes are first in SP+ and second in FPI. That's as wide a gap between perception and projection as you'll find in the Top 25.

fieldStorylines:matchup-2026-wk10-miami-.blurb: No. 1 Miami at No. 4 Notre Dame is a bye-line elimination game in everything but name: both are currently sitting in the top-four band, and only one can leave South Bend with its seeding intact.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech sits as the No. 14 seed, two spots outside the field and holding steady. The Red Raiders don't need style points so much as a clean November to climb in.
